title: My Mall World hot takes on some recent FAQs
content: I have had Mall World dreams my whole life, and I have some hot takes in response to some recent frequently asked questions. *What is Mall World?* Mall World is a vivid dreamscape that mirrors extremely common (mostly) public spaces. Literal shopping malls, of course, but also: schools, university campuses, flea markets, grocery stores, airports, hotels, hospitals, theaters, libraries, amusement parks, city streets, dorms, beaches, towns, apartments, museums, freeways, offices, suburban neighborhoods, parks, playgrounds, trains, etc., etc. They can be empty, liminal and spooky, or bustling with life and activity. There may be certain landscapes that appear the same across dreams, and others that appear one off, but fit the Mall World motif. *Mall World dreams are common, not special* Have you ever had a very vivid, life-like dream where you showed up to an important school or work presentation in your underwear? Or one where you entered a public restroom full of befouled toilets? Or are wandering around a massive parking garage seemingly designed by MC Escher? Congrats! You have visited Mall World. If you visit this sub, you’d think Mall World was some very special club for very special people, but they are literally dreamscapes that mirror everyday locations, most people experience to one degree or another in their waking lives. Pretty much everyone I talk to IRL has dreams that take place in something that resembles Mall World, at least occasionally. *GATE* Participation in gifted and talented education (GATE) programs in the US have nothing to do with Mall World. This is a worldwide phenomenon experienced by people all over the planet, of all ages, educational backgrounds, and walks of life. Hence, why I outright dismiss the GATE and similar conspiracy theories involving the US government and Mall World. A big reason for me posting these hot takes is the sheer number of posts clogging up my reddit feed recently of people questioning if they are actually visiting Mall World because they are not from the US and/or were never in a GATE program. *Neurodivergance* Normies have these dreams, too. *SSRI medications* You do not have to be on an SSRI to have Mall World dreams, but if you started experiencing these dreams after starting an SSRI, it is probably because extra vivid dreams are a side effect of SSRI’s for some people. *Why these dreamscapes in particular?* Human consciousness is quite the mystery. Maybe we all visit these similar places because of some universal collective unconscious we all share. Or! Crazy thought, maybe it’s because most of these Mall World locations strongly resemble totally mundane places we visit in everyday life? Have you noticed that people’s Mall World malls resemble the look and feel of malls of their youth? I am a child of the 80’s. My version of The Tower (one of the most commonly visited and archetypal Mall World locales) physically resembles a glass and steel skyscraper from the 1980’s. Mall World is a universal human phenomenon that seems to tap into some deep collective well of consciousness, yet still appears to be grounded in the individual’s personal life experiences. *So what is actually happening?* You are having some vivid dreams that take place in surreal landscapes that resemble common public settings. Maybe there is some woo woo mystical magical thing going on, maybe you just have to pee really bad and that is why you are dreaming about running around the mall looking for a restroom where all the toilets aren’t clogged. Regardless, you are not having these dreams because you are a very special and unique snowflake who drank the pink bubblegum flavored fluoride treatment instead of swishing and spitting, you are having them because they are a ridiculously common human experience.
